jurisdictions.name: Belvedere
jurisdictions.notes: Combined Planning & Building Department. Building permit applications are PDF forms (https://cityofbelvedere.gov/planning-building-applications-forms/); no online building permit portal found. The city's iWorQ portal (https://belvedereca.portal.iworq.net/portalhome/belvedereca) is linked only for encroachment permits. No dedicated ADU page; ADU application form: https://cityofbelvedere.gov/documents/accessory-dwelling-unit-application/. cityofbelvedere.org redirects to cityofbelvedere.gov.

jurisdictions.name: Corte Madera
jurisdictions.notes: Accela portal is linked from the town's Online Permit Center page (https://www.cortemadera.gov/1048/Online-Permit-Center); all submittals are electronic. townofcortemadera.org redirects to cortemadera.gov. Code enforcement line on the same page: (415) 927-5193.

jurisdictions.name: Fairfax
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is the number the page gives for building permits (Building Official). Same page: inspection line (415) 453-2263; Planning and Building department / Town Hall (415) 453-1584. No online permit portal found; applications are PDF forms (https://townoffairfaxca.gov/forms-permits/). townoffairfax.org redirects to townoffairfaxca.gov.

jurisdictions.name: Larkspur
jurisdictions.notes: eTRAKiT portal linked from the Building Division page; it handles Building, Public Works, Fire, and Planning permits. Technical code and fee questions: message line (415) 927-5033 (same page). Pre-approved ADU plans: https://www.larkspur.ca.gov/960/Pre-Approved-ADU-Plans. cityoflarkspur.org and ci.larkspur.ca.us redirect to larkspur.ca.gov.

jurisdictions.name: Mill Valley
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is listed in the Building page contact block and is also the City Hall number. The page links eTRAKiT as https://trakit.cityofmillvalley.org/eTRAKiT3/, which redirects to the recorded portal URL. cityofmillvalley.org redirects to cityofmillvalley.gov.

jurisdictions.name: Novato
jurisdictions.notes: UNVERIFIED LIVE: novato.gov returns HTTP 403 (Akamai Access Denied) to curl and to the fetch tool, including robots.txt. Phone and ADU link were read from the Wayback Machine copy of the Building Division page dated 2026-07-18 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260718053813/https://www.novato.gov/government/community-development/building-division), labeled 'General Inquiries'. The portal link (Novato Permits, MaintStar) was read from the archived Novato Permits page dated 2026-06-06; the portal itself returns 200. Re-check the novato.gov values in a browser.

jurisdictions.name: Ross
jurisdictions.notes: The town's main number; the Building Department contact block says 'Option 4'. Permit Technician: ext. 106; inspections: ext. 170 (same page). eTRAKiT is linked as 'Community Portal'; the town also accepts applications in person and by email. townofross.org redirects to townofrossca.gov. robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 15.

jurisdictions.name: San Anselmo
jurisdictions.notes: Building inspectors' general line: (415) 258-4618 (same page). townofsananselmo.org redirects to sananselmo.gov.

jurisdictions.name: San Rafael
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is the Building Division 'Office' line; inspection line (415) 485-3365. OpenGov replaced eTRAKiT for new applications from February 23, 2026 (https://www.cityofsanrafael.org/opengov/).

jurisdictions.name: Sausalito
jurisdictions.notes: The site moved to .php URLs; older search-indexed URLs such as /departments/community-development/building-division now return 404. eTRAKiT is linked from https://www.sausalito.gov/services/permits_and_licenses/permit_center/etrakit.php. Inspection line: (415) 289-4100 ext. 800.

jurisdictions.name: Tiburon
jurisdictions.notes: No online portal: applications are emailed to building@townoftiburon.gov (https://www.townoftiburon.gov/510/Apply-for-a-Building-Permit). No ADU page found in the site map, Planning Division, Long-Range Planning, or Housing Resources pages. Community Development main line: (415) 435-7390. townoftiburon.org redirects to townoftiburon.gov.

jurisdictions.name: Marin County
jurisdictions.notes: Community Development Agency, Building and Safety Division (issues permits for unincorporated Marin). UNVERIFIED LIVE: marincounty.gov, apps.marincounty.gov and cdaportal2.marincounty.org all return HTTP 403 (Cloudflare block) to curl and the fetch tool. Phone ('Building and Safety General Contact') and portal link were read from the Wayback Machine copy dated 2026-06-09 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260609193831/https://www.marincounty.gov/departments/cda/building-and-safety). The ADU and jurisdiction-lookup links were read from the archived CDA page dated 2026-09-26 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260926164924/https://www.marincounty.gov/departments/cda). That page describes the Jurisdiction Search Tool as 'Use this tool to identify which jurisdiction a property is located within.' The tool itself could not be opened. The same page links a zoning and property-information lookup for unincorporated parcels: https://apps.marincounty.gov/GeneralPlanLookup/. Re-check all values in a browser.
